_comment: NPC dialogue for wren (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: Your sibling swears the emberlings were walking in a line -- not scattering, walking -- and asks you to break the column.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Slay 5 Emberling. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: Wren wants four emberling embers sealed in a jar, to show Rowan the colour is wrong.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Gather 4 Emberling Ember. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: The mill's lower floor has been open since the sluice broke. Wren will not go down; you will.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Reach Entered Drowned Mill. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: A crowned goblin has been sitting in the mill's wheel-room, holding court over a drowned village.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Slay 1 Skarn the Goblin King. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: The crypts predate the Wardens. Wren wants to read what is on the door, and you would rather be standing next to Wren when it opens.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Reach Entered Hollow Crypts. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: Something in the crypts has been keeping a ledger of the dead for four hundred years, and it has Wren's name in it.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Slay 1 The Bone Titan. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: The ledger has Wren's name and a date that has not happened yet. Wren laughs. You notice Wren's hands are shaking.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Speak with Wren. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Wren
1.text: Four hollow relics off the cold ones -- Wren says they are the same metal as the shards, and Wren is right too often lately.

2.speaker: Wren
2.text: Gather 4 Hollow Relic. Come back to me when it is done.

barks.text: Race you to the well — no, actually, race you to the ridge.
Old Rowan says I ask too many questions. I say he gives too few answers.
If you go into the barrens again, take me with you. I'm quick.
The firelight makes the whole valley look like it's breathing.
